Method of Attack: Chained zero-day vulnerabilities in macOS allowing remote code execution by visiting a malicious web page.
First stage: Modified Terminal.app registered as handler for new file extension (.workingpoc) with a blank folder test.bundle set as default openfolder to auto-open Terminal.app without prompt.
Second stage: Unsigned shellscript with .workingpoc extension executed within running Terminal app without prompt.
Attack Vector: Visiting a specially crafted malicious web page using Safari
Indicators of Compromise: CVE-2017-13890 (CoreTypes.bundle allowing .smi Self-Mounting Images to be opened by Safari)
CVE-2018-4176 (Disk Images vulnerability with bless --openfolder argument launching .bundle applications)
CVE-2018-4175 (Gatekeeper bypass in LaunchServices via modified Terminal.app Info.plist)
